explanation: This fires only at D1, and only when the previous trial was a1 that reached S1 (common); it does not matter whether that trial was rewarded, and it is 0 at GO and D2, at every D1 after an a2 choice or after reaching S2, and at any D1 before about trial 73. Its size grows with time in the episode: about 1-3 around trials 74-85, 5-6 around trial 90, 7-9 around trials 92-95, and 9-10 from trial 96 to 99.
